name: Security Assessments
description: Machine and device security assessments for macOS, Linux, Windows, Android, Chromebook, iPhone and iPad, with explicit measured and manual coverage.

categories.name: security-audits
categories.description: Security audit reports, static analysis findings, and compliance baseline records

categories.name: security-hardening
categories.description: Applied hardening profiles, permission policies, and egress firewall rules

categories.name: security-events
categories.description: SSSS security events, rotation logs, and threat telemetry

secrets.description: Master encryption key for envelope encryption and credential hardening
Provider challenge verification credential; managed exclusively by auth

subcommands.name: platforms
subcommands.description: List native collectors and guided device review coverage

subcommands.name: device
subcommands.description: Guided review: --platform ios|ipados|android|chromeos|chromeos-flex|windows --device label [--stdin|--answers-json JSON]; never automatically verified

subcommands.name: android
subcommands.description: Limited device-property reads: --serial existing-authorized-adb-serial; never enables debugging

subcommands.name: machine
subcommands.description: Inspect local firewall, disk protection, effective SSH policy and listeners; --apply-permissions verifies local SSH permission repair

subcommands.name: network
subcommands.description: Inspect local network listeners and host security posture

subcommands.name: fleet
subcommands.description: Audit discovered mesh machines; optional --target hostname

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Display active security suite modules and crypto status

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Execute comprehensive file permission, egress policy, and SAST audit

subcommands.name: scan
subcommands.description: Run static analysis scanner for code injection and token leaks

subcommands.name: harden
subcommands.description: Prepare observed hardening plan; --apply-permissions repairs recognized local SSH metadata

subcommands.name: plugins
subcommands.description: Audit installed plugin source and auth declarations; manifests are never auto-rewritten

subcommands.name: secure-all
subcommands.description: Audit entire discovered mesh fleet with explicit coverage and remediation; no blanket secured claims

subcommands.name: encrypt
subcommands.description: Perform AES-256-GCM authenticated envelope encryption

subcommands.name: decrypt
subcommands.description: Decrypt AES-256-GCM envelope payload

subcommands.name: probe
subcommands.description: Real HTTPS response and security-header presence check; requires --url

subcommands.name: token
subcommands.description: Inspect or save the auth-managed security master key through stdin

subcommands.name: challenge
subcommands.description: Create, solve or verify authenticated proof-of-work challenges

subcommands.name: bot-mitigate
subcommands.description: Evaluate submission risk with optional provider challenge verification

subcommands.name: site-audit
subcommands.description: Review actual website security headers on an authorized HTTPS target

subcommands.name: site-shield
subcommands.description: Generate application middleware for review; does not claim installation

elements.description: Machine, network and mesh security audit console

view.description: Printed by `total-recall security token status --json`: { present, secretKey }
